sentences.text:
The Hon'Ble Sri Justice J. Sreenivas Rao
 Contempt Case No.1137 of 2020
Order:

This contempt case is filed to punish the respondent- contemnor for gross violation of the interim order passed by this Court, dated 28.08.2018 in I.A.No.1 of 2018 in Writ Petition No.29168 of 2018 invoking the provisions under Sections 10 to 12 of the Contempt of Courts Act, 1971.
2. No representation on behalf of the petitioner.

3. Heard the learned Assistant Government Pleader for Roads and Buildings appearing on behalf of respondent-contemnor.
4.

The grievance of the petitioner is that in spite of interim direction passed by this Court,
respondent-contemnor making interference with the property of the petitioner and therefore,
respondent-contemnor is liable for punishment.

5. Respondent-contemnor filed counter affidavit on 05.02.2021, wherein it is specifically stated in para No.6 as follows:
"6. I respectfully submits that the petitioner land is abutting to the R & B road.
The road is an old existing road with 66 fts wide and handover by the Panchayat Raj department long ago.
To strengthen and widen the road the R & B department took up the work within the Right of Way (ROW) of the R & B and executing the work by the Executive Engineer(R&B), Ranga Reddy District.

Since the R & B has taken up the road work within the available width of 33'-0"
from the centre of the road and no private lands were touched nor required for the road work, hence neither acquisition of the lands of Petitioner nor paying compensation does not arise in this case.
Therefore the question of paying compensation does not arise.
Hence the allegations made by the Petitioner duly stating that the respondent acting in flagrant violation of Act, is not correct, as no Land Acquisition is involved in this case.
The work is taken up within the existing available width of 66' ft road.
I submit that the Revenue authorities conducted the survey at the site with help of Village Map it is found that a 33' permanent road is existing.
This department following the due procedure under law and executing the road work.
If any private land is required this department will follow the procedure contemplated under law.

The present road work is executing by the Executive Engineer(R&B), Ranga Reddy District within the ROW and no private lands were touched, in executing the work the some debris fell into the petitioner land temporarily, the petitioner feels that the respondent is laying road in his land.
The photographs are filed herewith for kind perusal of this Hon'ble Court."

7. In view of the averments made in the counter, this Court is of the considered opinion that no further adjudication is required.
8. Accordingly, the Contempt Case is closed.
However, the petitioner is granted liberty to avail the remedies available under law in the pending writ petition.
Miscellaneous applications, pending if any, shall stand closed.
J. SREENIVAS RAO, J Date: 07.03.2025.
